description_en: Updates the configurations of a monitoring session
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-stream-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --monitor-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --input-list InputConfig --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveStreamMonitor

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the monitoring session.

Obtain the MonitorId value from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848129.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
监播室ID。
通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848129.html接口的返回参数获取MonitorId值
parameters.name: monitor_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the monitoring session
parameters.name: monitor_name

parameters.help_en: The output domain name for the monitoring session
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The application name for the output stream of the monitoring session. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify this parameter, monitor is used as the AppName
parameters.help_zh:
监播输出流的App。
名称可自取，不传默认用monitor作为AppName名称
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en: The name of the output stream for the monitoring session
parameters.name: stream

parameters.help_en:
The output template for the monitoring session. Valid values:

lp_ld: low definition.

lp_sd: standard definition.

lp_hd: high definition.

lp_ud: ultra-high definition
parameters.help_zh:
监播输出模版。类型取值：

lp_ld：流畅。
lp_sd：标清。
lp_hd：高清。
lp_ud：超清
parameters.name: output_template

parameters.help_en: The list of input streams to monitor. For more information, see the InputConfig table below
parameters.help_zh: 监控流输入列表。具体内容，请参考下表InputConfig
parameters.name: input_list

parameters.help_en: The settings for alert thresholds. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see the MonitorConfig table below
parameters.help_zh: 监播告警阈值设置，JSON格式，具体内容，请参考下表MonitorConfig
parameters.name: monitor_config

parameters.help_en: The webhook address. HTTP and HTTPS are supported
parameters.help_zh: 支持输入HTTP(S)格式的回调地址
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en:
The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot. Monitoring alerts are sent to a DingTalk group using a chatbot. Set up a chatbot and enter its webhook URL, which must be an HTTP or HTTPS address. For more information, see Custom robot access (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access).

Set the custom keyword of the DingTalk chatbot to "Alerting". Otherwise, messages cannot be received
parameters.help_zh:
监播钉钉告警通过钉群机器人进行告警信息的通知，请先设置钉群机器人，并在此输入机器人的HTTP(S)地址。详情请参见自定义机器人接入 (https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access)。

配置钉群机器人自定义关键词为“告警”，否则消息无法接收
parameters.name: ding_talk_web_hook_url
